verdict.rationale: Helicone documents deploying prompt versions independently to production, staging, and development environments, and a Playground for testing prompts. Together these let users test prompt changes outside production, but nothing shows a true sandbox that isolates logged request data from production. A Docker Compose self-host for local development exists, but a separate instance is a deployment arrangement rather than a built-in sandbox, so it earns no credit. missing for 10: a documented sandbox/test mode with data isolation from production logs, clear separation of test vs. production request data, independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can test against a sandbox environment without touching production data

citations.quote: Deploy different versions to production, staging, and development environments independently
Playground: Rapidly test and iterate on prompts, sessions and traces in our UI.
Test and deploy prompt changes instantly without rebuilding or redeploying your application
